TwitchClientId.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot never gives its Twitch login details to scripts. Reading it stops your code with a "not supported" error.

TwitchOAuthToken.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot never gives its Twitch login token to scripts. Reading it stops your code with a "not supported" error.

TwitchGetChannelPointsUsedByUserId.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot counts reward redemptions, not how many channel points a viewer spent. It only writes a warning in the log.

TwitchGetBitsDonatedByUserId.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot does not keep a total of the Bits each viewer cheered. It only writes a warning in the log.

SetChannelGameById.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot sets the Twitch category by its name, not its id. It only writes a warning in the log. Use SetChannelGame with the category name instead.

AddQuoteForTrovo.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot has no Trovo connection. It only writes a warning in the log.
AddQuoteForTrovo.example:
int quote = CPH.AddQuoteForTrovo("12345", "Best stream ever!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Quote number: {quote}");

SendTrovoMessage.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot has no Trovo connection. It only writes a warning in the log and sends nothing.
